reason: I'd go for the free first visit, but $14 a kid adds up fast with two little ones on one shift-work paycheck, and a monthly membership is out of the question. The library and the free park do the job for nothing.
objection: Fourteen dollars a kid for an hour of play when the library story time is free. Every visit would cost me $20 or more with siblings, and the coffee doesn't make up for it.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in of around $8 per child with a sibling discount that really cuts the cost, or a rainy-day pack that works out under $6 a visit.
